description: This file declares a utility library of functions for filesystem operations within the 'cuttlefish' project. Functions include checking file existence, creating links, copying files, directory management, reading file contents, and related filesystem queries. The header provides interface definitions for various file-related operations used elsewhere in the project.

methods.name: FileExists
methods.description: Checks if a file exists at the specified path, following symlinks by default.

methods.name: FileDeviceId
methods.description: Retrieves the device ID of the file at the given path.

methods.name: CanHardLink
methods.description: Determines if a hard link can be created between source and destination paths.

methods.name: Result<bool> CanRename(const std::string & source,const std::string & destination)
methods.description: Checks if a file can be renamed from source to destination using hard links.

methods.name: FileInodeNumber
methods.description: Gets the inode number of a specified file.

methods.name: AreHardLinked
methods.description: Checks if two files are hard linked (i.e., share the same inode).

methods.name: CreateHardLink
methods.description: Creates a hard link to the target file with optional overwrite.

methods.name: CreateSymLink
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link pointing to the target.

methods.name: HardLinkDirecoryContentsRecursively
methods.description: Recursively creates hard links of directory contents from source to destination.

methods.name: MoveDirectoryContents
methods.description: Moves contents of the source directory to the destination directory, leaving source empty.

methods.name: FileHasContent
methods.description: Checks if the specified file has any content.

methods.name: DirectoryContents
methods.description: Lists the contents of a directory.

methods.name: DirectoryContentsPaths
methods.description: Lists the full paths of the directory contents.

methods.name: DirectoryExists
methods.description: Checks if the directory exists.

methods.name: bool IsDirectory(const std::string & path)
methods.description: Inline function that confirms if the path is a directory.

methods.name: EnsureDirectoryExists
methods.description: Creates a directory and all necessary parent directories with specified mode.

methods.name: ChangeGroup
methods.description: Changes the group ownership of a file or directory.

methods.name: CanAccess
methods.description: Checks if a path can be accessed with specified mode.

methods.name: IsDirectoryEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the directory is empty.

methods.name: RecursivelyRemoveDirectory
methods.description: Removes a directory and all its contents recursively.

methods.name: Copy
methods.description: Copies a file from one location to another.

methods.name: FileSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the file in bytes.

methods.name: RemoveFile
methods.description: Removes (deletes) a file.

methods.name: RenameFile
methods.description: Renames or moves a file.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Reads the entire contents of a file into a string.

methods.name: ReadFileContents
methods.description: Reads the contents of a file, returning a Result type.

methods.name: MakeFileExecutable
methods.description: Sets the executable permission on a file.

methods.name: FileModificationTime
methods.description: Gets the last modification time of a file.

methods.name: FileIsSocket
methods.description: Checks if the file is a Unix socket.

methods.name: GetDiskUsageBytes
methods.description: Calculates disk usage of a path in bytes, including all nested files.

methods.name: GetDiskUsageGigabytes
methods.description: Calculates disk usage of a path in gigabytes.

methods.name: FindImage
methods.description: Searches for an image file matching patterns under a specified path.

methods.name: AbsolutePath
methods.description: Converts a path to an absolute path.

methods.name: CurrentDirectory
methods.description: Returns the current working directory.

methods.name: SparseFileSizes
methods.description: Returns sizes of a sparse file.

methods.name: FindFile
methods.description: Searches for a file with a given name under a directory.

methods.name: WalkDirectory
methods.description: Recursively walks through a directory, executing a callback for each entry.

methods.name: WaitForFile
methods.description: Waits for a file to appear within a timeout (Linux-specific).

methods.name: WaitForUnixSocket
methods.description: Waits for a Unix socket to be available within a timeout (Linux-specific).

methods.name: WaitForUnixSocketListeningWithoutConnect
methods.description: Waits for a Unix socket to be listening without connecting (Linux-specific).

methods.name: EmulateAbsolutePath
methods.description: Generates an absolute path considering process context and optional path information.
